title: Nasty Smell
text: Nasty Smell. I bought these because I figured they would be opaque, which they are. However, the cases are permeated with a horrible chemical smell which DOES NOT wash out.  If you really have bedbugs maybe it's worth it to you but otherwise be fore warned.
